issues.title: Scan issues
issues.lede: Scanned exams that could not be assembled automatically. Pick one to identify the student or check its pages.
issues.denied: You cannot resolve issues in this subject
issues.deniedBody: You need the resolve-issues permission. Ask the coordinator.
issues.caption: Scanned exams
issues.emptyBody: Every scanned exam is complete and identified.
issues.emptyAll: No exam has been scanned yet

instance.noneBody: Select a row to see its pages and fix its details.
instance.deleteBody: The exam, its pages and its grades are deleted. This cannot be undone.

pages.title: Pages
pages.caption: Scanned pages of the exam
pages.empty: This exam has no pages yet.
pages.discardBody: The page no longer counts for the exam. It stays recorded as discarded.

move.title: Move page {{n}}
move.body: It is now in the exam of {{from}}. It can only go to another exam of this same test.

orphans.title: Pages without an exam
orphans.caption: Scanned pages with no exam assigned
orphans.summary_one: There is {{count}} page without an exam in the organisation. Select an exam to attach it.
orphans.summary_other: There are {{count}} pages without an exam in the organisation. Select an exam to attach them.
orphans.emptyBody: When the scanner cannot read the QR of a sheet, it shows up here.
orphans.howTo: To attach a page, open the issues of the exam it belongs to and pick the student's exam.

create.title: Create scanned exam
create.body: For cases the scanner did not assemble. You can then attach pages without an exam to it.

scans.title: Scans
scans.lede: Upload scans by hand when they do not arrive from the scanner and check pages that could not be assigned.
scans.fileHint: PDF or image (PNG, JPG, TIFF). Every sheet must carry its QR code.

receipt.next: Recognition continues in the background. If the QR cannot be read, the page shows up under “Pages without an exam”.

engines.title: Recognition engines
engines.note: The default engine is chosen in the organisation settings. QR and checkboxes are not configurable.

errors.DIFFERENT_EXAM: You can only move pages between exams of the same test.
errors.TARGET_NOT_FOUND: The target exam no longer exists. Reload the list.
errors.PAGE_NOT_ORPHAN: That page is already assigned to an exam.
errors.DUPLICATE_STUDENT: That student already has another scanned exam in this test.
errors.MODEL_NOT_FOUND: That model does not belong to this exam.
